dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: We're not in any hurry to get going, are we? Let's chill here for a bit.

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: "When the cat's away, the mice will play." And so they should — 'cause it's only a matter of time before the cat gets back and gobbles all the mice up.

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: So like I said — no need to hurry. The mice will be there for us when we're ready.
